name: zeffect_anim_save_activation_records
description: zEffect_Anim::SaveActivationRecords serializes queued activation records into Activation#### ZAR sections, rebinding matching entries and appending tracked object3d node state.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x460490 uses a fixed stack save buffer, iterates g_zEffectAnim_ActivationRecordTable while writes succeed, copies the 0x50-byte activation record prefix, formats Activation%04d, and writes 0x58 + trackedNodeCount * 0x44 bytes through zUtil_ZAR::WriteSectionBlob.

For a matching zEffectAnimEntry it saves activationState and trackedNodeCount, rebinds the entry to GameZ_ZBD::NodeIndexToPtr(record->nodeToken), and records each valid Object3D tracked node's validated node index, active flag, cached-matrix flag, transform data, and DI flag/value.
For a missing entry or missing tracked-node list it stores savedActivationState=0 and trackedNodeCount=0.
known_limits: code/function tier S byte verification remains deferred to a coherent zEffect animation save/load source-cluster pass.
